# vim-vsnip runtime snapshot

Upstream: https://github.com/hrsh7th/vim-vsnip

Pinned commit: `9bcfabea653abdcdac584283b5097c3f8760abaa`

Unmodified runtime directories and MIT license are included; tests and development tooling are omitted.
`manifest.json` records archive and per-file SHA-256 values. Markdown loads this runtime on first use;
no plugin manager, Python provider or runtime download is required.
